name: ash

scripts.prepare:backend: node build/python.ts -B build/prepare.py && node build/python.ts -B build/desktop/develop.py --select-prepared
scripts.prepare:desktop: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all -n native,generated,backend "pnpm run rebuild:native" "pnpm run prepare:generated" "pnpm run prepare:backend"
scripts.predev:ui: pnpm run rebuild:native && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.predev:web:full: pnpm run prepare:generated && pnpm run prepare:backend:web
scripts.pretest:extensions: pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.pretest:unit: pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.pretest:editor:unit: pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:generated
scripts.build:stanza: bun build/resources/localization.ts && bun check -p tsconfig.common.json --all && bun check -p build/desktop/vite/stanza/tsconfig.json --all && vite build --config build/desktop/vite/editor.vite.config.ts
scripts.test:main: pnpm run stylelint && pnpm run test:build-tools && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:unit:runner
scripts.test:extensions: node test/unit/prepare.ts tsconfig.extensions-test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.extensions-test.json && node test/unit/extensions.ts
scripts.test:unit: node test/unit/prepare.ts tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/unit/run.ts
scripts.test:editor:unit: node test/unit/prepare.ts tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/unit/editor.ts
scripts.pretest:smoke:ui: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm run build && bun check -p test/automation/tsconfig.json --all
scripts.test:smoke:ui:debug: pnpm run pretest:smoke:ui && node test/smoke/run.ts electron-ui --debug
scripts.test:runners: node --test build/processes.test.ts build/testEnvironment.test.ts build/testRunners.test.ts build/smokeRunner.test.ts build/frontend.test.ts build/desktop/web.test.ts test/unit/mocha.test.ts
scripts.pretest:smoke:browser: pnpm run build:web && bun check -p test/automation/tsconfig.json --all
scripts.pretest:smoke:browser:dev: pnpm run prepare:generated && bun check -p test/automation/tsconfig.json --all
scripts.test:smoke:browser:debug: pnpm run pretest:smoke:browser && cross-env ASH_PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER=disconnected node test/smoke/run.ts browser-ui --debug
scripts.pretest:smoke:browser:full: pnpm run build:web:full && bun check -p test/automation/tsconfig.json --all && pnpm run prepare:backend:web
scripts.test:loading: cross-env ASH_LOADING_BASELINE=1 pnpm run test:smoke:browser:full --grep 'production loading baseline' --repeat-each=3
scripts.pretest:smoke:desktop: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm run build && bun check -p test/automation/tsconfig.json --all
scripts.test:smoke:desktop:debug: pnpm run pretest:smoke:desktop && node test/smoke/run.ts electron-app-server --debug
scripts.pretest:app: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm run build && bun check -p test/automation/tsconfig.json --all
scripts.pretest:app:pdf-corpus: pnpm run prepare:backend && pnpm run build && bun check -p test/automation/tsconfig.json --all
scripts.typecheck:stanza: bun build/resources/localization.ts && bun check -p tsconfig.common.json --all && bun check -p build/desktop/vite/stanza/tsconfig.json --all
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-host,app-server "vite --config build/desktop/vite/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_DEV_APP_SERVER_RELOAD=1 ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node build/desktop/launch/electron.ts --watch" "node build/desktop/watch-app-server.ts --skip-initial"
scripts.dev:ui: concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-host "vite --config build/desktop/vite/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_DESKTOP_UI_ONLY=1 ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node build/desktop/launch/electron.ts --watch"
scripts.dev:ui:connected: pnpm run prepare:desktop && concurrently -k -n renderer,electron-host "vite --config build/desktop/vite/vite.config.ts" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node build/desktop/launch/electron.ts --watch"
scripts.bundle:web: cross-env ASH_WEB_APP_SERVER=0 vite build --config build/desktop/vite/vite.config.ts --mode web
scripts.bundle:web:full: cross-env ASH_WEB_APP_SERVER=1 vite build --config build/desktop/vite/vite.config.ts --mode web
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ASH_DEV_APP_SERVER_RELOAD=1 ASH_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node build/desktop/launch/electron.ts --watch
scripts.prestart: pnpm run prepare:output && pnpm run prepare:desktop
scripts.package:desktop:win32: pnpm package:win32:bundle && pnpm package:win32:verify && pnpm package:win32:installer
scripts.test: pnpm run verify:protocol && pnpm run test:main
scripts.scenario: pnpm prepare:backend && pnpm build && pnpm run scenario:compile && node test/scenario/out/runScenario.js
scripts.test:unit:prepared: node test/unit/prepare.ts tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/unit/run.ts
scripts.build:stanza:prepared: bun check -p build/desktop/vite/stanza/tsconfig.json --all && vite build --config build/desktop/vite/editor.vite.config.ts

description: Electron client for the Ash app-server protocol
